hero.name: Md Nazmus Sakib
hero.bio: I design, build, and study AI systems that genuinely work with people. My research asks: how do humans make sense of AI, and how can we design interactions that feel trustworthy, transparent, and human?

paragraphs: I'm a PhD student passionate about making AI systems that genuinely work for the people using them. Before grad school, I studied [background]. I'm advised by Prof. [Advisor] at [University] and affiliated with [Lab Name].
Outside the lab I love traveling, photography, and anything that gets me outside.
